Thin plate spline mirror registration for CRANT

Source: R/data.R
crant_mirror_tps.Rd

A nat::tpsreg() registration that maps points in the CRANT brain (in microns) to their mirror image on the opposite side. Use it via crant_mirror().

Usage

crant_mirror_tps

Format

An object of class tpsreg of length 4.

Details

The registration was made by registering an X-flipped image of CRANT synapse density (1 um voxels, synapse snapshot v523) onto the original with warpfield (https://github.com/danionella/warpfield). Points on a 12 um grid in neuropil were mapped through this registration to give mirror landmarks; the TPS was fitted to those left of the midline (x ~ 202 um) in both directions, so that it is very nearly its own inverse. On held out grid points it agrees with the warpfield mirror to ~1 um (median; 90% < 3.3 um) and mirroring twice returns points to within 0.1 um (median). See data-raw/crant-synapse-density.R, data-raw/crant-mirror-warpfield.py and data-raw/crant-mirror-tps.R.

See also

crant_mirror()
